description: Celebrating one of the most iconic Wethepeople frames of all time, we are proud and excited to offer a limited-edition reissue of the legendary Wethepeople 4 Seasons frame! Originally released in 2001, the 4 Seasons was our very first “modern”, “double-diamond” style frame which made waves in the BMX world when it first dropped and quickly became an absolute staple in the BMX scene for the following two decades. We took extra care and attention to recreate a frame which pays homages to the original V1 4 Seasons in both aesthetics and styling, whilst incorporating new-school technology and easily enjoyable geometry. From the oversize stays, cupped style bearing shells and classic tubing silhouette, we wanted to stay close to the original design whilst creating a frame that every kind of rider could love and enjoy, newcomer or seasoned veteran. The mellower head tube and welded brake mounts keeps the mid-school vibes strong, whilst the overall slimmed down tubing, reduced weight and specially designed integrated head tube and Mid BB shapes allow a hassle free build up and none of the back pain from the past. Built to be collected, displayed, ridden, and loved, this was a project of passion fuelled by almost 30 years of making the very same bikes we ride every day. Fully backed by our Lifetime Guarantee, the 4 Seasons is reborn.
